key_insight: Frontier LLMs can write and inspect small neural networks, but these abilities largely reflect compiling hand-designed programs into weights and recognizing input-layer layouts.
engineering_relevance: Direct weight generation and inspection could support small-network prototyping and preliminary security screening, but do not yet provide deep behavioral interpretation.
method: Replicated direct weight generation for Breakout and tested modified games and handwritten-digit classification.
Decompiled generated networks into Python and tested action agreement.
Evaluated game identification from weights and screening of poisoned models and malicious adapters.
evidence_signal: Generated Breakout networks scored 514, 550 and 307 versus the prior report’s 517; digit accuracy averaged 50% versus an 82% baseline, while malicious-adapter detection succeeded in 23 of 32 cases.
watch_item: This three-day study examined small networks; weight-only auditing detected some compromised models but never identified their triggers or malicious behavior.
paper_title: Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers
